title: modbus-simulator trace record v1
description: One JSONL trace record emitted per served Modbus request. Machine-generated by modbus-simulator run --trace. ts and durationMs are informational and excluded from assert-trace matching.

schemaVersion.description: Trace format version. Must be exactly modbus-simulator.trace.v1.

ts.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the request was served (wall clock; not used in assertions).

seq.description: Monotonic sequence number per simulator process, starting at 1.

unitId.description: Target Modbus unit id for this request.

request.description: Normalized request fields including derived area.

response.description: Outcome: success values, Modbus exception, or transport fault.

stateChanges.description: State mutations from writes (empty array for reads, FC43, exceptions, and faults).

decoded.description: Optional typed codec decode overlay when run --trace-decoded is enabled and the fixture uses codec fields fully contained in the request window.

matchedRule.description: Id of the exception/fault rule that fired, unknownAddress when that policy applied, or absent/null otherwise.

raw.description: Optional hex-encoded PDU bytes (disabled by default; not used in assertions).

durationMs.description: Handler duration in milliseconds (wall clock; not used in assertions).

scalar.description: Coil/discrete boolean or register integer value.

request.description: Normalized request record. area is derived from fc so consumers need not map FC to memory area.

name.description: Stable handler name, e.g. read_holding_registers, write_single_register.

area.description: Memory area derived from fc. identity for FC43.

values.description: Multiple values for FC15/FC16 writes. Must be non-empty when present.

meiType.description: FC43 MEI type (14 for read device identification).

readDeviceIdCode.description: FC43 read device identification code / category.

objectId.description: FC43 individual object id when requested.

response.description: Response outcome. ok:true with values for reads; ok:true without values for successful writes; ok:false with exceptionCode or fault on failure.

ok.description: true when the request completed successfully.

values.description: Read result: booleans for coils/discrete, integers for registers.

exceptionCode.description: Modbus exception when ok is false.

fault.description: Transport fault when ok is false.

identity.description: FC43 device identification payload when ok is true.
FC43 identity objects returned in the trace.

stateChange.description: One mutated point from a write. Multi-writes produce one entry per address in ascending order.

area.description: Memory area that changed (writable areas only).

decodedField.description: One decoded codec field from a fixture register span.

area.description: Memory area of the decoded field.

address.description: Start address of the codec field.

value.description: Decoded typed value when decode succeeded.

error.description: Decode error message when decode failed at trace time.
